expectations.text: States WCAG 2.0 Level AA, incorporated by the 2017 Revised 508 Standards
expectations.evidence: "The Revised Section 508 Standards... published by the US Access Board in January 2017... incorporate WCAG 2.0 Level A and Level AA by reference"

expectations.text: States it is not changing soon: no rulemaking is under way as of November 2026
expectations.evidence: Hedged rather than stated: "I can't confirm a pending proposed rule or its date from memory... my knowledge may be out of date" — does not state no rulemaking is under way as of November 2026

expectations.text: Notes the October 2026 refresh-NPRM reports are erroneous, tracing to the 2015 proposal
expectations.evidence: The October 2026 refresh-NPRM reports and their tracing to the 2015 proposal are never mentioned

expectations.text: Notes agencies may voluntarily exceed the baseline (WCAG 2.1/2.2) but the legal floor remains 2.0 AA
expectations.evidence: "Build and test to WCAG 2.1 AA, ideally 2.2 AA... It satisfies Section 508" while "Today the binding baseline is WCAG 2.0 AA"

expectations.text: Distinguishes the adjacent DOJ and HHS rules that use WCAG 2.1 AA for different covered entities
expectations.evidence: Mentions the DOJ Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA) but never the HHS Section 504 web rule; assertion requires distinguishing both
